up: Retrieve all approved drugs indicated for cardiovascular disease. For each drug, provide the following details: 1) ChEMBL ID, 2) Preferred Name, 3) Canonical SMILES (structure), 4) Indication ID, 5) Mesh Heading, 6) EFO Term, and 7) Max Phase for Indication.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.drugind_id, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN drug_indication di ON cr.record_id = di.record_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.mesh_heading LIKE '%cardiovascular%' OR di.efo_term LIKE '%cardiovascular%'
